description: Stockholms Skyfallsmodell 2024 (TK) is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stockholms stad. Skyfall is intense rain that can lead to saturation of the soil and overloading of the stormwater system. This, in turn, can cause floods and cause disturbances and damage that affect both individuals and important societal functions. Coverage: Stockholms stad. The portal shows the English title as "Stockholm Skyfall model 2024 (TK)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stockholms stad. Its keywords include Tjänst för åtkomst till karta, Fullständiga metadata, Extern dataportal, Trafikplanering. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, HTML. The listing shows 2025-06-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
